meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 当用户要求查看项目代码知识图谱时,Claude 会启动一个本地网页仪表盘来展示该图谱,并给出带 token 的网址;若项目还没生成图谱,会提示先运行 /understand。
howto.when: 当用户要求打开或启动代码知识图谱仪表盘,或调用 /understand-dashboard 技能时触发;可附带项目路径,缺省使用当前工作目录。

say.text: 启动当前项目的知识图谱仪表盘
say.note: Claude 会启动本地网页,并给你带 token 的网址

say.text: 把 /path/to/project 的知识图谱在浏览器里打开
say.note: Claude 会先检查图谱文件是否存在

howto.what_en: Claude locates the project's knowledge-graph file, starts a local web dashboard to visualize it, and returns a tokenized URL for the user. If the graph file is missing, it tells the user to run /understand first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to open or launch the knowledge-graph dashboard, or invokes the /understand-dashboard skill, optionally with a project path; defaults to the current working directory.

say_en.text: Start the knowledge-graph dashboard for the current project.
say_en.note: Claude starts a local web page and shares a tokenized URL.

say_en.text: Use understand-dashboard to open ~/my-app's code graph.
Show /path/to/project's knowledge graph in the browser.
say_en.note: Claude checks for the graph file first.
